name: Ivan Kovačić
bio: Ivan's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly while volunteering at a local rally event in his hometown. Enthralled by the logistical complexity of coordinating race events, he pursued a degree in supply chain management. After graduating, Ivan worked his way up through smaller racing teams, focusing on optimizing parts inventory and transportation schedules. He is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to ensuring seamless operations, often pushing his team to meet his high standards. What sets Ivan apart is his ability to anticipate potential logistical bottlenecks and proactively implement solutions, preventing disruptions before they occur.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ivan is a lean man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of Croatian coffee beans in the office
Always color-codes his spreadsheets using a system only he understands
